slides.title: prompts that build you a real sleep reset plan
slides.sub: Audit, routine, rules, tracker, done in 2 weeks.
slides.voiceover: If you're falling asleep at 2am again, this is for you.

slides.name: The Sleep Audit
slides.sub: Find out what's actually breaking your sleep
slides.prompt: Act as a sleep coach. Here's my night: [DESCRIBE YOUR EVENING, BEDTIME, PHONE USE, CAFFEINE]. List the 3 biggest problems, rank them by impact, and give me **ONE SMALL CHANGE** to start tonight.
slides.tip: Be honest about the phone-in-bed part — that's usually problem #1.
slides.voiceover: First, it audits your actual night and ranks what's really breaking it.

slides.name: The Wind-Down Architect
slides.sub: A 45-minute routine that actually gets you sleepy
slides.prompt: Build me a 45-minute wind-down routine before my target bedtime of [TIME]. Include a **SCREEN CUTOFF**, one calming activity, and a fallback version for nights I only have 15 minutes.
slides.tip: Keep the fallback version — a broken streak kills the habit faster than a short routine.
slides.voiceover: Then it designs a wind-down routine, plus a short version for busy nights.

slides.name: The Screen-Time Contract
slides.prompt: Write me a screen-time contract for the hour before bed: which apps are **BANNED** after [TIME], what I'm allowed instead, and one honest consequence if I break it. Keep it realistic, not extreme.
slides.tip: One realistic rule you keep beats three strict ones you quit by Wednesday.
slides.voiceover: This one writes screen rules strict enough to work, but realistic enough to keep.

slides.name: The Bedroom Reset
slides.sub: Fix the room, not just the habit
slides.prompt: Here's my bedroom setup: [LIGHT, NOISE, TEMPERATURE, WHAT'S ON YOUR NIGHTSTAND]. Give me a **BEDROOM CHECKLIST** to fix before my next reset attempt, cheapest fixes first.
slides.tip: Ask for cheapest-first — most fixes here cost nothing.
slides.voiceover: Next, it checks your actual room, cheapest fixes first.

slides.name: The 2-Week Reset Calendar
slides.sub: Move your bedtime gradually, not all at once
slides.prompt: I currently fall asleep at [CURRENT TIME] and want to fall asleep by [TARGET TIME]. Build me a **2-WEEK CALENDAR** that shifts my bedtime gradually, day by day, with what to do if I miss a day.

lines: Day 4-9: hold, add the wind-down routine
Day 10-14: shift the last 15 min, lock it in

slides.voiceover: Then it builds a two-week calendar that moves your bedtime gradually.

slides.name: The Tracking Sheet
slides.prompt: Build me a simple daily sleep tracker template: bedtime, wake time, how rested I feel out of 10, and one note field. After 7 days, tell me what to ask you to **ADJUST THE PLAN**.
slides.tip: One week of honest numbers beats a month of guessing how you slept.
slides.voiceover: And the last one gives you a tracker, so you can see it actually working.
